description: This file appears to be a Polymer mini HTML source file defining Polymer base features, including template handling, DOM manipulation, custom element behaviors, and shadow DOM distribution logic. It contains embedded JavaScript code that extends Polymer's core functionalities.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: A utility class providing DOM API features for Polymer elements, including node import, attribute management, observer registration, and node distribution handling.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: A class managing the class list of an element, proxying add, remove, toggle, and contains methods.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observer class monitoring effective nodes, especially for nodes distributed into shadow DOM or content projection, with ability to add/remove listeners.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for tracking distributed nodes in content insertion points.

methods.name: Polymer.dom
methods.description: Factory function to get a DOM API wrapper for an element, event, or document.

methods.name: _prepShady
methods.description: Prepares shady DOM features, setting flags for content usage and DOM distribution.

methods.name: _poolContent
methods.description: Pools light DOM content for later distribution or stamping, if applicable.

methods.name: _createLocalRoot
methods.description: Creates a local shadow root for distribution of light DOM content.

methods.name: _distributeContent
methods.description: Triggers content distribution into shadow roots and content insertion points.

methods.name: _distributeDirtyRoots
methods.description: Distributes content into dirty roots that need update.

methods.name: _finishDistribute
methods.description: Completes the content distribution process, updating the DOM tree.
